outOfScope: Migrating, deleting or cutting over any current unfinished legacy Blackboard task.
Rewriting DONE task history or Living Docs.
constraints: Task 1 builds the new control plane only. It must not migrate or cut over any current unfinished legacy work.
Blackboard authority must be readable identically from any checkout/worktree and must not depend on whichever source branch is currently checked out.
A new Work must be creatable directly in the control plane before any source PR or branch exists.
Context is derived output, not authority: no context generation/history/currentContextRef persistence in the V2 model.
Source branches, worktrees and candidate SHAs are attempt bindings only and never become Blackboard truth.
Independent Jev judgment, exact candidate/evidence/merge binding, negative-case verification and Living Docs delivery truth remain trust primitives; V2 may adapt them but must not weaken them.
The lifecycle and legal next actions must be executable state-machine data/code; operator docs may explain semantics but cannot be required to infer what action is legal next.
invariants: Exactly one configured authority owns Work; reads from different checkouts are equivalent during a quiescent resourceVersion and never fall back to Git branch data.
Work.generation increments only on semantic spec changes; resourceVersion covers every status/spec mutation and stale decisions never apply.
Store-clock leases and persistent monotonic fences reject stale mutations; actor time cannot authorize takeover; read-only operations need no Attempt fence.
All lifecycle actions have executable guards, and pure nextActions/context consume only explicit immutable snapshot facts.
Actor-authored candidate/evidence records cannot alter spec, judge correctness or publish delivery; exact trusted Decision/receipt binding is required.
BB-155 creates only new synthetic V2 Work and leaves legacy current-work authority and all task records unchanged.
Contexts are derived values without stored identity/history; read-only phases grant zero product-source write authority.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Implement an isolated Node 24+ control service under scripts/blackboard-v2. Select a single configured service and server-owned SQLite database outside all source checkouts. Git control refs were considered but rejected: remote Git CAS does not supply a trusted lease clock. No legacy task import or cutover in BB-155.

D2 — ControlStore uses node:sqlite, WAL, synchronous=FULL, foreign_keys=ON and bounded busy_timeout=5000 on a local disk; no NFS or multi-host direct SQLite writers. All mutations acquire BEGIN IMMEDIATE, check expected resourceVersion and complete with one COMMIT. Clients access the same service; actor clients never access SQL or authoritative files. Service authorityId/database/controller digest are pinned in out-of-checkout client configuration. Missing/unreachable/wrong authority fails closed; no checkout-local fallback.

D3 — Work is {id,resourceVersion,generation,spec,status}. generation is on Work, never spec.generation. spec owns immutable-by-actor objective/plan/dependencies/components and authorized future write scope. A semantic spec update increments generation and revokes prior readiness/active Attempt; status-only mutations increment resourceVersion only. Decisions bind observedGeneration to Work.generation. Returned records are canonical JSON with sorted keys/collections, finite safe integers, strict schemas, no contexts.

D4 — Store time is sampled inside the serialized transaction from the service host clock. Persist lastCommittedTime. Reject CLOCK_REGRESSION when sampled time is earlier, including after restart, instead of trusting actor timestamps or silently clamping. Lease interval is [issuedAt,leaseUntil); equality expires. Claim/renew/takeover use this clock. A persistent per-Work fenceCounter increases on every new ownership, including after semantic generation changes. Expired tokens fail every Attempt mutation even if status has not yet observed expiry.

D5 — lifecycle.mjs owns a closed action/phase table and pure nextActions({spec,status,decisions}); blockers use explicit validated snapshot facts. Store-owned reconciliation publishes observed dependency and lease-expiry facts; controller time never enters the pure function. Every apply transaction repeats all guards, so a stale next result grants no write. Base failed candidate judgment is BLOCKED/SUPERVISION_REQUIRED; BB-157 adds LOOKBACK/reflection semantics through the declared lifecycle extension. Base never grants direct repair from failed judgment.

D6 — Pure buildContext(snapshot,systemFacts) consumes nextActions and immutable current-system/component facts supplied by the reader. It returns goal, bound refs, read/write/forbidden scope and required output, performs no I/O or clock reads and creates no file, context generation or currentContextRef. Source write scope appears only for fenced EXECUTING/REPAIRING; research may change only current plan; judgment and failed-judgment block expose zero product writes.

D7 — Attempts are immutable-identity records plus append-only candidate/evidence versions owned by the current lease token. They bind workId,workGeneration,specHash,kind,owner,attemptId,fence,lease,baseSha/sourceRef/worktree and exact candidate SHA/tree/evidence set. Semantic input cannot be overwritten through source payloads. Read/show/context require reader identity only; candidate/evidence/lifecycle effects require matching live fence and action guards. Existing source processes cannot be physically undone by a lease; stale outputs are rejected at authority and publication boundaries.

D8 — Independent judge capability alone publishes Jev Decisions. Trusted adapter materializes exact state/questions and validates model/policy, all required typed answers, canonical subject hashes, stateHash/specHash/cacheKey, negative-case and evidence bindings using delivered validators. No actor can synthesize SATISFIED. Decision insert plus status application is one CAS transaction; stale generation/Attempt/candidate/evidence/phase is retained as immutable SUPERSEDED without Work mutation. Identity-id retries are idempotent only for exact same canonical bytes; changed bytes under same id reject.

D9 — Delivery remains trusted receipt verification after evaluated candidate is in main with exact evaluated tree and unchanged required sources/Living refs. MERGE_PENDING is not DELIVERED. DeliveryReceipt binds Work generation/spec, Attempt, Decision, candidate SHA/tree, actual merge/main SHAs and consolidated Living refs. No service merge or provider dispatch is inferred from reflection/status text. Controller code/runtime are independently pinned; source branch scripts cannot replace them.

D10 — Provide an authenticated loopback HTTP service for one host (0600 operator token file outside checkout), with reader/actor/judge/operator capabilities and bounded strict JSON. CLI uses explicit BB_CONTROL_URL plus expected authorityId or an absolute external config; neither cwd nor source remote discovers authority. Future remote clients require a trusted TLS transport before exposure; BB-155 does not deploy a public service. Start/create/show/next/context/apply work for synthetic new V2 ids without any source PR or legacy writes.
implementationSlices: S1 — control-store.mjs/work-resource.mjs: implement strict Work/spec/status/record schemas and server-owned SQLite transaction store described by D2-D4. Expose readSnapshot/createWork/apply/readRecord, never raw replacement. BEGIN IMMEDIATE, unique allocation, expected RV/generation CAS, durable lastCommittedTime and per-Work fenceCounter, server-clock leases, exact idempotence and rollback. Semantic revision invalidates current readiness/Attempt without resetting fence. Reject unknown actor fields and stale tokens before record or status writes. No Git-ref authority or actor-clock expiry.

S2 — lifecycle.mjs: implement the eight explicit transition rows D5 and declared pure nextActions contract. Guards cover phase, spec/plan completeness, current independent readiness, direct Work/Living dependency facts, exact current Attempt, candidate/evidence/Decision/receipt binding. Failed candidate -> BLOCKED/SUPERVISION_REQUIRED; no direct repair. All effects go through apply and repeat guards with store clock/fence. Store-owned dependency/lease reconciliation produces canonical observed facts; pure next has no clock/I/O. Reserve LOOKBACK/reflection extension for BB-157 without implementing supervision here.

S3 — context-builder.mjs: implement pure buildContext(snapshot,systemFacts), immutable binding projection and phase-local scopes D6. Read-only judgment/block/merge contexts expose no product writes; research permits only current plan data; executable Worker requires exact plan/readiness/dependency/lease facts. No context file/currentContextRef/history or source-directory discovery. Reader resolves component/Living blobs before projection.

S4 — server.mjs/cli.mjs: start Node24+ authenticated loopback authority from an external absolute local-disk DB/token/config. Pin authorityId/controller digest; create/show/next/context and POST guarded action surface D10. Canonical show output contains no cwd/read timestamp, and wrong/missing authority never falls back to branch graph. New Work create/start research needs no Git branch or PR. Bound sizes/timeouts and role separation; do not deploy remote/public service.

S5 — trust-adapter.mjs/test/blackboard-v2-control.test.mjs: use existing pinned validators for exact independent Jev and delivery receipts; immutable Decision insert/status CAS is atomic, stale subjects SUPERSEDED with unchanged Work. Test actual SQLite multi-process CAS, restart clock rollback, takeover/fence, actor-field injection, two different checkout CLI reads, complete table transitions, pure no-I/O contexts, forged/stale decision/receipt and no source/legacy mutation. Update only declared Living state and package scripts. Prototype scratch model is feasibility evidence, not product implementation or real Jev authority.

negativeVerificationCases: Changing the checked-out source branch changes `bb-v2 show` state for the same Work id, or competing agents both acquire the same live lease because agent clocks decide expiry.
A stale judgment/attempt bound to an older Work generation is published as current instead of returning SUPERSEDED, or two controllers derive different nextActions from the same canonical snapshot.
A stale fence mutates candidate/evidence/status, or read-only inspection/context building incorrectly requires a fence.

authorityContract.schema: metadata(authorityId,schemaVersion,controllerDigest,authorityMode,lastCommittedTime,allocationNextId); works(id PRIMARY KEY,resourceVersion,generation,specJson,statusJson,fenceCounter); attempts(id PRIMARY KEY,workId,generation,canonicalJson); records(id PRIMARY KEY,kind,workId,generation,hash,canonicalJson). Foreign keys and uniqueness enforce exact identities. All backing state is service authority, not Git.
authorityContract.transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> schema/auth/action validation -> sample trusted service Date.now -> CLOCK_REGRESSION check against durable lastCommittedTime -> compare expected resourceVersion/generation -> current lease/fence/subject checks -> records+Work+allocation update -> update lastCommittedTime -> COMMIT. Any exception ROLLBACK including allocation and inserted receipts. Busy timeout returns RETRYABLE_BUSY without effects. No unguarded file replace.
authorityContract.clock: Production clock cannot be supplied in request. Injectable test clock exists only at server construction in test harness. Positive safe-integer ttl range1000..3600000ms; lease expires at now>=leaseUntil. Renew requires same current owner/Attempt/fence and unexpired lease; takeover only after store time expiry. Process restart reopens same database, never resets lastCommittedTime/fenceCounter. Clock rollback blocks mutating operations; show remains readable.
authorityContract.result: canonical Work show contains no read timestamp/cwd/connection-local data. Quiescent reads have identical bytes. Error codes distinguish NOT_FOUND, WRONG_AUTHORITY, UNAUTHORIZED, CAS_CONFLICT, LEASE_HELD, STALE_FENCE, CLOCK_REGRESSION, PHASE_FORBIDDEN and RETRYABLE_BUSY. Mutations never accept full actor-authored Work replacement.

resourceContract.Work: {id:BB-n,resourceVersion:positiveInteger,generation:positiveInteger,spec:{objective:{ref,hash,body},plan:{ref,semanticHash,body}|null,dependencies:[{workId,requires,source:WORK|LIVING,binding?}],components:[id],writeScope:[path],forbiddenWrite:[path]},status:{phase,observedGeneration,activeAttemptRef|null,readinessDecisionRef|null,latestCandidateDecisionRef|null,conditions:[{type,observedGeneration,subjectRef,subjectHash,reason}],dependencyFacts:[{workId,state,refs,hash}],leaseState:NONE|LIVE|EXPIRED,blockers:[code]}}. Strict keys/types; stable sort by ids; uniqueness and acyclicity checked in store transaction.
resourceContract.generation: create=1. Only operator/research authorized REVISE_SPEC mutates semantic desired state: compare RV, increment generation, set RESEARCHING, clear applicable readiness/conditions/activeAttempt, fenceCounter remains durable. Updating candidate/status or recording superseded Decision increments RV only when Work changes; it cannot bump generation to evade findings.
resourceContract.records: Attempt/Decision/DeliveryReceipt bodies live in the same store. Immutable refs use {kind,id,hash}; raw evidence blobs retain exact immutable external refs/hashes. Candidate/evidence versions are append-only records, while status contains only current refs. No context state. Record insertion conflicting existing id/hash rejects; equal insertion is idempotent.

lifecycleContract.pureSignature: nextActions({spec,status,decisions}) -> {actions:[{id,requiredInputs,preconditions}],blockers:[{code,refs}],forbidden:[actionId]}; canonical ordering; no random ids, clock, I/O or hidden controller state. Decisions/records resolved into explicit status facts in one authoritative read snapshot. apply repeats pure table guards and transaction-owned fences/clock.
transitions: PROPOSED + START_RESEARCH -> RESEARCHING; valid objective/components/spec; no source branch required.
RESEARCHING + PUBLISH_PLAN -> PLAN_JUDGMENT; current objective-bound complete plan and research Attempt.
PLAN_JUDGMENT + PUBLISH_DECISION -> READY only all required claims SATISFIED; any other outcome -> RESEARCHING; freshness and independent judge capability mandatory.

READY + CLAIM_EXECUTION -> EXECUTING only current readiness and all direct WORK dependencies DELIVERED / external LIVING facts validated. Research may run ahead; Worker never bypasses dependency blockers.
EXECUTING/REPAIRING + PUBLISH_CANDIDATE -> JUDGING only current lease/fence and exact candidate/evidence subject; agent output cannot satisfy criteria.

JUDGING + PUBLISH_DECISION -> MERGE_PENDING for all SATISFIED; PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION -> RESEARCHING and revoke readiness; other non-satisfied -> BLOCKED reason SUPERVISION_REQUIRED in BB-155. BB-157 extends this edge with LOOKBACK; no direct REPAIRING edge.
MERGE_PENDING + PUBLISH_DELIVERY_RECEIPT -> DELIVERED only exact trusted merge/main/tree/Living validation; no direct DONE from a success command.

BLOCKED exposes reason and guarded operator/research action only; no source write; a trusted lease reconciliation may expose TAKE_OVER with exact transaction recheck. DELIVERED terminal mutation rejected.
lifecycleContract.extension: Base declares status record refs and action dispatch extension seam. BB-157 adds LOOKBACK/PUBLISH_REFLECTION in lifecycle.mjs using supervision validation; no change to CAS/clock/fence implementation is needed. The core has no actor bypass around apply(action).
lifecycleContract.leaseReconciliation: Service controller observes expiry and direct dependency delivery into canonical status using a guarded store transaction. It uses store time and no actor fence because it owns control observation, not Attempt outputs. Spec/generation never change. Before reconciliation an action may be blocked; mutation guards always reject expired tokens independently.

contextContract.signature: buildContext({spec,status,decisions},systemFacts) -> {goal,inputs,readScope,writeScope,forbidden,requiredOutput,bindings}. Caller resolves records, Living docs/component profiles and source refs beforehand; builder never reads disk, scans directories, mutates store or persists output.
contextContract.routing: PROPOSED/RESEARCHING uses current objective/current plan only and output READY_IMPLEMENT_PLAN; writes only research plan. PLAN_JUDGMENT/JUDGING/MERGE_PENDING/BLOCKED has empty product writeScope and exact judgment/evidence/merge inputs. EXECUTING/REPAIRING yields exact plan scope only when current readiness, dependencies and live Attempt status facts hold; server rechecks live fence on effects. DELIVERED has only Living truth and no writable action.
contextContract.binding: Output includes exact Work spec/generation, resolved record hashes and system-fact hashes as evidence binding, not a Context identity/generation. It contains no createdAt, parent context, currentContextRef or history chain. Repeated builds on immutable inputs are byte-equivalent.

trustContract.Attempt: {id,workId,workGeneration,specHash,kind:RESEARCH|IMPLEMENTATION,owner,fence,issuedAt,leaseUntil,baseSha?,sourceRef?,worktree?,candidateVersionRefs:[ref],evidenceVersionRefs:[ref]}. Actor may append only named source identity/evidence fields through guarded actions, cannot mutate Work/lease/fence or replace earlier records.
trustContract.Decision: {id,workId,observedGeneration,specHash,attemptRef,subject:{objectiveHash,planHash,candidateSha?,candidateTree?,evidenceSetHash?},jev:{model,policy,stateHash,specHash,cacheKey,answers,evaluationRef/evaluationHash},storeSequence,publication:APPLIED|SUPERSEDED}. Sequence assigned inside store transaction, not actor timestamp. Independent trusted adapter validates all required answers and evaluation bindings; model/policy and outcomes stay delivered existing policy.
trustContract.publication: Check exact Work generation+spec hash+current Attempt identity/fence+exact current candidate/evidence and phase under CAS. Stale but structurally valid trusted Decision is immutable SUPERSEDED and never changes Work status/phase/conditions. Wrong capability or forged/malformed receipts reject rather than retaining purported correctness. Concurrent spec edit vs Decision application serializes into one winner; loser cannot resurrect readiness.
trustContract.DeliveryReceipt: Existing trusted verifyDelivery-equivalent checks execute in pinned controller adapter over exact immutable source objects: candidate ancestor of actual merge; merge ancestor of observed main; evaluated candidate tree==merge tree; declared required source/Living blobs unchanged; trusted all-SATISFIED candidate Decision binds same Work/Attempt. Receipt has candidateSha,candidateTree,mergeSha,observedMainSha,planHash,evidenceHash,decisionRef,consolidatedRefs. Missing Git object or invalid bound evidence is blocker, never inferred PASS.
trustContract.adapters: New trust-adapter.mjs imports existing delivered canonical/hash, validateEvaluation, negative-case and delivery validators from pinned controller installation. Candidate checkout supplies bytes/data only; its scripts never define control lifecycle or Jev semantics. Any adapter needs explicit root/snapshot bound to subject; no root inferred from client cwd. Provider dispatch is reserved once by exact Work generation/Attempt/candidate/evidence/cacheKey in CAS; BB-157 further restricts material retry.
trustContract.limits: Prototype synthetic Decisions test binding/control safety only; no new real SATISFIED result is claimed by this plan. Trusted receipts, real Jev and exact merge verification remain required in Worker evidence.

coexistenceContract.mode: BB-155 authorityMode=ISOLATED_NEW_WORK; legacy ids cannot be imported/claimed/dual-written. New synthetic V2 ids allocate independently with authority namespace and collision checks; Work ids that already exist in legacy are denied until explicit BB-156 import transaction. No legacy graph/context/artifact/CI changes. Service endpoint config is operator supplied, not checked into candidate branches.
coexistenceContract.deliveryBoundary: BB-155 Worker proves synthetic mode only. BB-156 owns authority selector/cutover and removal of legacy readers. BB-157 owns failed-candidate LOOKBACK/reflection policy. Both consume the exact published base API; delivered divergence reopens research instead of compatibility guessing.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: From two different source checkouts/worktrees, `bb show <WORK_ID>` resolves byte-equivalent authoritative Work state from one control-plane authority.
A brand-new work item can be created and enter research without first merging a source-code registration PR.
The V2 Work resource separates desired semantic state from observed lifecycle state and provides an explicit revision/generation binding for stale judgment detection.
`bb next <WORK_ID>` derives the bounded legal next actions and blockers from executable lifecycle state without requiring jev.md or previous conversation.
`buildContext(<WORK_ID>)` derives the current agent goal, inputs, read/write authority, forbidden actions and required output without persisting a context artifact.
Source branch/worktree/candidate identity is recorded only as an Attempt bound to a Work and cannot redefine the Work objective/plan or lifecycle authority.
V2 can run against empty/new Work resources in parallel with the legacy Blackboard, with no migration or dual-write of current legacy tasks in this task.
